entries.instrument: Virginia DEQ guidance, Air and Renewable Energy Division

entries.summary: DEQ ordered approximately $2.5 million after a Leesburg data center exceeded its air permit running backup generators during a four-day substation outage. Reported as the agency's largest civil penalty.
